page_note: Heavily damaged page (77.4% damage). Page contains tail end of zodiac correspondence teaching (teeth = Aquarius/Pisces), then a teaching about powers/archons inhabiting the body (840 myriads, four-by-four by house, totaling 210 myriads of houses) and what happens when they leave at death (wounds, saltwater flow, healing). Chapter 71 then opens: 'Concerning the Gathering-Inward of the Elements' with the Illuminator's question about how elements gather inward — fire to fire, wind to wind. Substrate dominates substantially. The dialogue frame at i=4 and i=27 is purely formulaic and bracketed off; the rest is systematic cosmological-anthropological teaching with internal mappings (cosmic powers → body parts, elements → element). Editorial fatigue is negative (substrate increases in second half), confirming substrate-dominant page.
